content.text:
VERDICT: LGTM

The change is structurally clean and idiomatic for this mapper.

- `formatFiscalYear` mirrors the established `format*` method convention exactly: same null-guard shape, `@Named` with the doc note about MapStruct selection, `String.format`, and the `@Mapping` entry slotted next to the related `membershipNumber`/`membershipPoints` mappings.
- The new private `fiscalYearStart(LocalDate)` helper is the right deduplication move: the "fiscal year starts 1 July" rule now has a single home shared by all three consumers (`formatMembershipNumber`, `formatFiscalYear`, `formatMembershipPoints`) instead of being repeated inline. The helper is well-documented and named for what it returns.
- Logic lives at the right altitude. The surrounding code already keeps simple date arithmetic inline (`formatAgeBand` uses `Period`, the old `membershipPoints` used `ChronoUnit` inline) rather than pushing it into a util class like `TelephoneNormalizer`/`LuhnCheckDigit`, so keeping `fiscalYearStart` as a private helper here is consistent — extracting it to a new util would be over-engineering.
- No new catch-all: the mapper already hosts a family of read-only derived fields, and this adds one more in the same style, so a maintainer would find it natural.
- Docs (javadoc and `openapi.yml`) are updated coherently alongside the behaviour change, keeping the field descriptions in sync.
